headline: Giorgetti: "The EU will decide in October on the safeguard clause"
summary: Italian Economy Minister Giancarlo Giorgetti said the EU will decide in October on the safeguard clause, with Italy requesting maximum flexibility for energy and 0.9% for defence.
why: The EU fiscal safeguard clause determines how much extra deficit spending member states such as Italy can run, which affects sovereign debt supply and bond yields.
